observations: Two car headlights wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with multiple horizontal LED strips.
The plastic lenses appear clear and undamaged.
The internal components are visible through the plastic wrap.
The items are resting on a cardboard surface.
A watermark 'JUJU AUTO PARTS' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap is intact and the lenses appear clean in photo 0.
The plastic wrap obscures the actual condition of the lenses and the internal bulb sockets.

risks.proof: A photo of the headlights without the plastic wrap.
risks.if_unproven: as having surface scratches or haze

risks.risk: The internal bulb sockets may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.

risks.risk: The LED strips may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlights powered on.

proof_requests: Photo of the headlights without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.
Photo of the headlights powered on to check the LED strips.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
